create_AndroidEnvError: create a custom exception by subclassing AndroidEnvError with a unique ERROR_CODE value
raise_ReadObservationError: raise ReadObservationError when the environment cannot obtain an observation from a simulator
raise_CoordinatorError: raise CoordinatorError when the Coordinator encounters an unrecoverable issue during execution
raise_TooManyRestartsError: raise TooManyRestartsError when restart attempts exceed the maximum allowed restart tries
from_code: call from_code with an integer error code and message string to get the matching AndroidEnvError instance
